senses.definition: n.pr.loc. south of Gaza, usually identif. with mod. Umm Jerâr BdPal. 159 GuérinJudée ii. 257 ff.; but Wady Jerūr W. of ʿAin Ḳadīs according to Trumbull Kadesh Barnea 61 ff. cf. Guthe ZPV viii. 1885, 215; Gn 20:2; 26:6, 20, 26; 2 Ch 14:12, 13; גְּרָ֫רָה Gn 10:19; 26:1; נַ֫חַל גְּרָר Gn 26:17; וַיָּגָר בִּגְרָר Gn 20:1.
